questions.q: Why did Jho Low start lying at Harrow School?
a: He wanted to keep up with far wealthier classmates
He was hiding that his family was poor
He hoped to impress his teachers
He was trying to avoid being bullied
questions.why: His family was worth millions, but he still felt like a small fry beside the elite.

questions.q: What did Low do when friends visited his home in Malaysia?
a: Rented a billionaire's house and yacht and swapped in family photos
Hosted them at his family's modest home
Took them to a government palace for dinner
Bought a small yacht and hired a crew
questions.why: The stunt helped him become known at school as the prince of Malaysia.

questions.q: Why did Low let Najib Razak take credit for the Mubadala investment deal?
a: It won him a powerful friend who could later give him a fund
He was afraid of attracting public attention
He owed Najib a large personal debt
He wanted to avoid paying Malaysian taxes
questions.why: Najib gained credentials, and Low gained influence with a future prime minister.

questions.q: What was the 1MDB fund supposed to do?
a: Raise money in the Gulf and invest it in Malaysian development
Finance Hollywood films and celebrity events
Pay pensions for retired Malaysian civil servants
Build a new capital city from scratch
questions.why: The summary describes it as a sovereign wealth fund for economic development projects.

questions.q: What finally brought Low's fraud to public attention?
a: A disgruntled insider released evidence to newspapers
An accountant at 1MDB confessed to investigators
Interpol traced the stolen money through Europe
A Hollywood celebrity reported him to the police
questions.why: Justo Xavier leaked the evidence in 2014 after the fund's backers refused to pay him.
